#!/bin/bash
# Runs once, as root, before the agent starts: Harbor's [environment.healthcheck] unpacks this folder into
# /var/lib/mimo and runs it. Generated by mimo_harbor; see its README for how each step maps to Xiaomi's harness.
M=/var/lib/mimo
[ -f "$M/ready" ] && exit 0
chmod 700 "$M"
fail() { echo "setup: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# the answer-leak blocklist (mimoagent), applied to /etc/hosts by the agent right after it installs
write_blocklist() { cp "$M/files/blocklist" "$M/blocklist"; }

# Terminal-Bench rows (in the General domain): the Harbor convention itself. Scrub test leftovers from the image and
# remember what was in the workspace, so harness residue can be told apart from the agent's work at grading time.
rm -rf /tests
find /logs/verifier -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
ls -A /app 2>/dev/null > "$M/before" || true

# Task fix (HAR-105): the pinned image lacks tqdm, which
# /app/vendor/project/lm_eval/models/huggingface.py imports both in the
# agent workflow (tools/run_fixture.py) and at grading time. Install once at
# setup so agent and verifier share it; the agent stays offline and must not
# pip-install itself.
python3 -m pip install --quiet tqdm || fail 'pip install tqdm failed'

touch "$M/ready"
echo "setup done"

schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/candidate-1702-ml-inference"
description = "Repair nested text-config context-length resolution in a frozen language-model evaluation harness."
keywords = ["mimo-v2.6-rl", "terminal"]

[metadata]
adapter = "mimo_harbor 1.1.0"
category = "Terminal tasks"
domain = "terminal"
keywords = ["terminal", "Terminal tasks", "Terminal-bench style", "English", "model_inference", "debugging", "compatibility"]
original_allow_internet = false
reference_harness = "XiaomiMiMo/verl a2ad9f6 + XiaomiMiMo/mimoagent 467f0a1"
reference_step_limit = 500
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "candidate-1702-ml-inference"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
title = "Repair nested text-config context-length resolution in a frozen language-model evaluation harness."

[agent]
timeout_sec = 900.0

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 240.0
user = "root"

[environment]
docker_image = "docker.io/xiaomimimo/mimo-v2.6-rl-oss@sha256:6b1a826116bf2f23e68ae41c36cb74a4173a25b563d3eb80a0e7e207bb41446b"
workdir = "/app"
cpus = 1
memory_mb = 2048
storage_mb = 10240
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 1800.0

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0
interval_sec = 5.0

rationale: 1702: install missing tqdm at setup so tools/run_fixture.py imports for both agent workflow and verifier; nop then fails on behavior without import errors; setup.sh is re-embedded in the task.toml healthcheck payload, which is what actually runs
